# subvolume: # A.R.K. package-owned code stays on the root filesystem under /ark.
# Only mutable state is split into dedicated Btrfs subvolumes, so package
# installation can never be hidden by a mount at /ark/runtime or /ark/graveyard.
# /run/ark is volatile and is created by systemd tmpfiles at boot.
# /etc/ark is configuration and stays on the root filesystem.
# New images use /ark directly and intentionally create no legacy root alias.
